c.v: nodes implement fault confinement by each maintaining two error counters, where the counter values determine the error state.
The two error counters are known as the Transmit Error Counter (TEC) and Receive Error Counter (REC).
TWAI has the following error states.
An Error Active node is able to participate in bus communication and transmit an Active Error Flag when it detects an error.
An Error Passive node is able to participate in bus communication, but can only transmit an Passive Error Flag when it detects an error.
Error Passive nodes that have transmitted a data or remote frame must also include the Suspend Transmission field in the subsequent Interframe Space.
A Bus Off node is not permitted to influence the bus in any way (i.e., is not allowed to transmit anything).
